note:
The ideal gas law has $P V = n R T$ with:
$P$ - pressure
$V$ - volume
$n$ - number of particles
$R$ - constant
$T$ - temperature
Rearrange terms and you get $P = R \rho T$, with $\rho$ particle density (per unit volume). $\rho T$ is very roughly energy density (maybe *kinetic* energy density) and with some hand-waiving, you get that pressure is pretty much defined to be proportional to energy per unit volume (amount of force exterted on a unit volume), giving us the formula.
